summary: Code review PASS. All 28 new locale keys in ViewTexts/Locales/en-US.json reviewed against the four quality dimensions. Implementation is clean, correctly structured, and precisely follows the plan's Step 1 specification. No blocking issues identified.

comments.note: Key naming conventions are consistent and self-documenting: 'Guidance*' prefix for sidebar cards, 'Confirm*' prefix for confirmation dialog, '*Tooltip' suffix for per-item tooltips — all matching the pre-existing 'InsertedWarningTooltip' and 'ConfirmUpdate*' patterns. Zero regressions on prior keys.

{0} placeholder placement is architecturally correct: present in all CountFormat keys and in ConfirmUpdateMessage_RiskyChanges/ConfirmRiskyDetail_Removals/ConfirmRiskyDetail_Insertions; correctly absent in all CountSingular keys and ConfirmRiskyDetail_*Singular keys. The ConfirmUpdateMessage_RiskyChanges format string ends {0} with a leading newline on the next line, which correctly contracts with the ViewModel's bullet-line composition pattern (caller appends trailing newline to each detail line before formatting).

The 'mod(s)' informal plural pattern in CountFormat strings (e.g., '{0} mod(s) removed') is consistent with the existing project convention for count strings (e.g., ShowChangesButtonTextWithCount uses '{0} changes'). Not a regression — acceptable at this scope.

[documentation-forward] The localization manifest (Docs/Agents/project-manifest/localization.md) does not document the singular/plural key-pair pattern introduced here (CountFormat with {0} paired with CountSingular with hardcoded '1'). Future translators adding non-English locale files will need to know this pattern exists, when to use each key, and that {0} in CountFormat always receives an integer >= 2. Consider adding a 'Plural Forms' section to the manifest describing this contract.
